headline: Consolidated Edison (NYSE:ED) Flashes Technical Breakout Setup with High Setup Rating
summary: Consolidated Edison (ED) shows a strong technical breakout setup with a 7/10 uptrend and a 9/10 consolidation pattern, offering a defined entry above resistance for a potential move higher.
